 For the State : Mr. S.K. Tiwari, A.P.P.

 Oral Order
 03 / Dated : 23.03.2023
Heard learned counsel for the parties.

The petitioner named above has been made accused in connection with Borio (J) P.S. Case No. 204 of 2022 for the offence under Sections 354(C), 34, 376 (AB) of the Indian Penal Code, Sections 66(C), 66(D) of I.T. Act and Section 4 of POCSO Act.
As per the prosecution case, as set out in the FIR, objectionable videography of the victim aged about 12 year was made and the same was uploaded on the social media.
During course of investigation, it has come that the victim girl was enticed away by the petitioner and rape was committed with her and video of the incidence was made viral.
It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that there was past enmity and the mother of the petitioner had filed Complaint Case No. 563 of 2022 against the informant of the present case.
The present case has been lodged only to pressurize the petitioner to compromise the case.
There is no whisper regarding kidnapping and rape in the FIR which is a product of afterthought and has been added in the investigation.

1 girl of 12 years and the factum of incidence has been supported by her in statement made under Section 164 of Cr.P.C.
